headline: Record quarter beats guidance on datacom demand
summary_short: Sales rose 65% to $10.2B, with 37% organic growth, and adjusted EPS grew 74% to $0.80. Orders of $12.2B gave a book-to-bill of 1.19. Fourth-quarter sales are guided to $10.3B-$10.5B.
summary_long: Both sales and adjusted EPS beat the high end of guidance. Amphenol bought back $245M of stock and paid $308M of dividends, raised the quarterly dividend 20% to $0.15, and approved a new three-year $4B repurchase plan effective January 2027. It closed Empire Electronics and signed three more acquisitions. Full-year sales are guided to $36.9B-$37.1B and adjusted EPS to $2.82-$2.84; CommScope is now expected to add $5.1B of 2026 sales.
confidence_notes: Per-share figures are adjusted for the 2-for-1 stock split paid September 2026. Adjusted EPS, adjusted margin and free cash flow are non-GAAP. Guidance excludes acquisitions not yet closed.

drivers.explanation: Strong organic growth in most end markets, especially exceptional growth in IT datacom, plus contributions from the acquisition program including CommScope.
Record orders in the quarter produced a book-to-bill of 1.19:1.
CEO says the revolution in electronics continues to accelerate, creating growth opportunities across each of Amphenol's end markets.
